title: World Series 2026: Here’s Where to Watch the Tampa Bay Rays vs. Milwaukee Brewers Live Online Free
summary: Livestream the MLB championship series starting on Friday, (Oct. 23).
contentText:

The end of the 2026 MLB Playoffs come down to two teams in the World Series, the American League champions Tampa Bay Rays and National League champions Milwaukee Brewers. Both teams are competing for their first-ever Commissioner’s Trophy, so the series is going to be one for the history books no matter which team wins.

Watch on DirecTV

In 2026, the Tampa Bay Rays (98-64) takes on the Milwaukee Brewers (103-59) with Game 1 at American Family Field in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The Brewers have home field advantage throughout the series.

How to Watch 2026 MLB World Series Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Oct. 23-Oct. 31

- Matchup: Tampa Bay Rays vs. Milwaukee Brewers

- Network: FOX

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , FOX One

When Does the 2026 MLB World Series Start ?

Tampa Bay Rays vs. Milwaukee Brewers broadcasts on starting Friday (Oct. 23) with first pitch at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT. The MLB championship series airs live on FOX.

Who Is Performing During the 2026 MLB World Series?

The World Series is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance for games in Milwaukee and Florida. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, include Rays fans John Cena, Brittany Snow, Eric Church and others; Brewers fans Tom Brady, Stephen Colbert, Eric Benét and others.

Where to Watch the 2026 MLB World Series Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch the World Series, if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , offer free trials, so you can watch for free.
